options.name: acls
options.description: The ACLs to apply to this backend.

options.name: actions
options.description: The actions to apply to this backend.

options.name: advanced
options.description: The per server pass thru to apply to each server line.

options.name: advanced_backend
options.description: The backend pass thru to apply to the backend section.

options.name: agent_checks
options.description: Enables or disables using a TCP connection to read an ASCII string of the form.

options.name: agent_inter
options.description: The interval (in milliseconds) between agent checks.

options.name: agent_port
options.description: Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: balance
options.description: The load balancing option to use for servers assigned to this backend.

options.name: balance_uridepth
options.description: The maximum directory depth to be used to compute the hash. One level is counted for each slash in the request.

options.name: balance_urilen
options.description: The number of URI characters the algorithm should consider when hashing.

options.name: balance_uriwhole
options.description: Enables or disables allowing the use of whole URIs, including URL parameters.

options.name: check_type
options.description: The health check method to use when checking the health of backend servers.

options.name: checkinter
options.description: The interval (in milliseconds) in which health checks will be performed.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: The amount of time (in milliseconds) to wait before giving up on connections.

options.name: cookie_attribute_secure
options.description: Enables or disables assigning the secure attributes on cookies for this backend.

options.name: email_level
options.description: The maximum log level to send emails for. Leave empty to disable sending email alerts. If left empty, the value set in the global settings will be used.

options.name: email_to
options.description: The email address to send emails to. If left empty, the value set in the global settings will be used.

options.name: errorfiles
options.description: The HAProxy error file mappings to use for this backend.

options.name: haproxy_cookie_domains
options.description: The domains to set the cookies for.

options.name: haproxy_cookie_dynamic_cookie_key
options.description: The dynamic cookie secret key. This is will be used to generate dynamic cookies for this backend.

options.name: haproxy_cookie_maxidle
options.description: The max-idle time to allow. This option only applies to insert mode cookies.

options.name: haproxy_cookie_maxlife
options.description: The max-life time to allow. This option only applies to insert mode cookies.

options.name: httpcheck_method
options.description: The HTTP method to use for HTTP health checks.

options.name: log_health_checks
options.description: Enables or disables logging changes to the health check status

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: monitor_domain
options.description: The domain to use for SMTP or ESMTP health checks.

options.name: monitor_httpversion
options.description: The HTTP version to use for HTTP health checks.

options.name: monitor_uri
options.description: The URL to use for HTTP health checks.

options.name: monitor_username
options.description: The username to use for MySQL or PostgreSQL health checks.

options.name: name
options.description: The unique name for this backend.

options.name: persist_cookie_cachable
options.description: Enables or disables allowing shared caches to cache the server response.

options.name: persist_cookie_enabled
options.description: Enables or disables cookie based persistence.

options.name: persist_cookie_httponly
options.description: Enables or disables preventing the use of cookies with non-HTTP components.

options.name: persist_cookie_mode
options.description: The mode HAProxy uses to insert/prefix/replace or examine cookie and set-cookie headers.

options.name: persist_cookie_name
options.description: The string name to track in Set-Cookie and Cookie HTTP headers.

options.name: persist_cookie_postonly
options.description: Enables or disables only inserting cookies on POST requests.

options.name: persist_cookie_secure
options.description: Enables or disables prevention of cookie usage over non-secure channels.

options.name: persist_stick_cookiename
options.description: The cookie name to use for stick table.

options.name: persist_stick_expire
options.description: The maximum duration of an entry in the stick-table since it was last created, refreshed or matched.

options.name: persist_stick_length
options.description: The maximum number of characters allowed in a string type stick table

options.name: persist_stick_tablesize
options.description: The maximum number of entries allowed in the table. This value directly impacts memory usage.

options.name: persist_sticky_type
options.description: The sticky table mode to use for this backend. These options are used to make sure subsequent requests from a single client go to the same backend.

options.name: retries
options.description: The number of retry attempts to allow after a connection failure to the server.

options.name: server_timeout
options.description: The amount of time (in milliseconds) to wait for data transferred to or from the server.

options.name: servers
options.description: The pool of servers this backend will use.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: stats_admin
options.description: The admin to make use of the options disable/enable/softstop/softstart/killsessions from the stats page.

options.name: stats_desc
options.description: The verbose description for this node.

options.name: stats_enabled
options.description: Enables or disables the HAProxy statistics page for this backend.

options.name: stats_node
options.description: The short name displayed in stats and helps differentiate which server in the cluster is actually serving clients.

options.name: stats_password
options.description: The stats page password.

options.name: stats_realm
options.description: The realm that is shown when authentication is requested by HAProxy.

options.name: stats_refresh
options.description: The interval (in seconds) in which the stats page is refreshed.

options.name: stats_scope
options.description: The frontends and backends stats to be shown, leave empty to show all.

options.name: stats_uri
options.description: The statistics URL for this backend.

options.name: stats_username
options.description: The stats page username

options.name: strict_transport_security
options.description: The HSTS validity period for this backend. Leave empty to disable HSTS.

options.name: transparent_clientip
options.description: Enables or disables using the client-IP to connect to backend servers.

options.name: transparent_interface
options.description: The interface that will connect to the backend server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
